# BAD-003 — Mark a fixture entry anonymous in npm run web:fixtures

## Brief
Guest mode (BAD-002) added an anonymous mark to catalog entries. The brief asked that the local catalog web:fixtures generates carry a marked entry so the guest path is testable, but scripts/web-fixtures.js was not among Goldrush's deliverables, so today the mark has to be added by hand after each regeneration.

Evidence: scripts/web-fixtures.js calls publishScene per fixture with no anonymous option; publishScene now accepts anonymous:true. A one-line change (anonymous: entry.name.startsWith('fixture-dub-scene')) would make the dev loop's catalog carry one marked entry. Workaround used: node scripts/showcase.mjs mark fixture-dub-scene-me8horfs0000 --anonymous --out web/scenes.

## Size, persona and model decision
One engineer spudagent on sonnet, no children: a one-line option in scripts/web-fixtures.js plus a doc touch; verified by regenerating the catalog twice (one anonymous entry, identical bytes) and npm test.
